project_name: A Bayesian Approach to Predict Solubility Parameters
summary: This project proposed modeling Hansen solubility parameters with Gaussian-process regression on chemical descriptors and sigma profiles, comparing molecular kernels from the GAUCHE framework\cite{griffiths_gauche_2024} against an existing Bayesian treatment used as benchmark and dataset\cite{sanchez-lengeling_bayesian_2018}. The submission stayed at the proposal stage: no code or results were published.
